camel_example: aliyun sls GET /logstores/ali-test-logstore/shards/1?type=log --region cn-hangzhou --cursor MTQ0NzMyOTQwMTEwMjEzMDkwNA --end_cursor MTU1NzA1NzQwMTEwMjEzMDkwCg --query '0_where_userId=_123' --count 1000 --header "Accept-Encoding=lz4" --header "Content-Type=application/json"
description_en: Call the PullLogs operation to retrieve log data from a specified cursor position. This operation retrieves raw logs. To query or analyze logs, call the GetLogsV2 operation
description_zh: 调用PullLogs接口获取指定游标（Cursor）位置的日志数据。此接口获取的是原始日志，如要查询或分析日志，请使用GetLogsV2接口
kebab_example: aliyun sls pull-logs --project ali-test-project --log-store ali-test-logstore --shard-id 1 --cursor MTQ0NzMyOTQwMTEwMjEzMDkwNA --count 1000 --end-cursor MTU1NzA1NzQwMTEwMjEzMDkwCg --query 0_where_userId=_123 --accept-encoding lz4 --region cn-hangzhou
name: PullLogs

parameters.help_en: The ID of the shard in the Logstore
parameters.name: shard_id

parameters.help_en: The cursor that specifies the start position from which to read data
parameters.help_zh: 游标，表示从什么位置开始读取数据，相当于起点
parameters.name: cursor

parameters.help_en: The number of LogGroups to return. The value must be an integer from 1 to 1000
parameters.help_zh: 返回的Loggroup数目，最小值为1，最大值为1000
parameters.name: count

parameters.help_en: The cursor that specifies the end position at which to stop reading data
parameters.help_zh: 结束游标，表示读取数据到什么地方结束，相当于终点
parameters.name: end_cursor

parameters.help_en: The filter statement in the Structured Process Language (SPL) syntax. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2536530.html
parameters.name: query

parameters.help_en: The compression format of the data that the server returns. Only the lz4 format is supported
parameters.help_zh: 期望服务端返回的数据压缩格式，支持 lz4
parameters.name: accept_encoding
